title: Bruce Lee fears the man who has repeated one kick …
text:
Bruce Lee fears the man who has repeated one kick … Rumors News & Analysis Salaries Player Rankings NBA 2K Rankings Free Agency NBA RUMORS Bruce Lee fears the man who has repeated one kick …
 HoopsHype Oct. 28, 2026, 6:39 a.m. ET Maxime Aubin: To explain his progression curve in isolation, Victor Wembanyama says he wants to simplify his game, and quotes Bruce Lee: « Bruce Lee fears the man who has repeated one kick 1,000 times, and not 1,000 different kicks once ».
